description.value: Netrunner armored skinsuit. Can store Cyberdeck and support Interface Plugs. Can't be bought in two pieces. Always worn on both Head and Body Location. Adds one Hardware only Option Slot to connected Cyberdeck. No armor penalty.
Plugs in the wrist or head to allow you to connect to machines/systems hands-free.

information.notes:
Lone Netrunner

Lieutenant · Netrunner

Thin, pale, plugs in the back of the skull. Takes jobs through Net boards and never shows up to meetings in person.

Tactics: Interface 6. Jacks into an access point 6 m from the target and stays in cover.

HP 40 · Seriously Wounded 20 · Death Save 5

Made with the “Night City · Interactive Map” module. Art is up to you.
